decision_basis: declared task request, task-specific reserve, current capacity, and candidate-attributable footprint
calibration_note: The v1 absolute 4 GB system-memory stop floor sat inside this workstation's normal available-memory band (idle about 7 GB, dips to about 3.7 GB under external load) and false-stopped a 26 MB candidate during a real supervised loop. v3 stops for memory only when the candidate's own footprint exceeds the envelope it reserved, or when free system memory falls below a genuine near-out-of-memory floor set below that normal band.

runtime_stop.basis: stop only for danger the candidate itself can relieve, or a genuine near-out-of-memory system floor set below the normal fluctuation band
